Title: Senior Design Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Design Manager to lead design initiatives for defense projects in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will oversee the design strategy, execution, and delivery of complex defense systems and components. You will manage cross-functional teams, ensure compliance with stringent defense industry standards, and drive innovation while maintaining the highest levels of precision and security. This position offers the opportunity to shape cutting-edge defense solutions and lead a talented group of design professionals.

* Lead and manage the design team, providing strategic direction, mentorship, and performance feedback to ensure excellence and professional development
* Oversee the complete design lifecycle for defense projects, from concept development through final delivery, ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards
* Develop and implement design strategies that align with project objectives, regulatory requirements, and organizational goals
* Manage project budgets, resource allocation, and risk mitigation to ensure successful project completion within scope and schedule
* Ensure all designs comply with defense industry standards, international regulations, and UAE-specific security and compliance requirements
* Collaborate with stakeholders, including engineering, procurement, and client representatives, to define requirements and resolve design challenges
* Conduct design reviews and quality assurance checks to maintain technical excellence and identify areas for continuous improvement
* Analyze complex technical problems and provide innovative solutions that balance performance, cost, and manufacturability
* Maintain detailed documentation and design records in accordance with defense sector protocols and security guidelines
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in defense design and project management

  
**Qualifications**  

* Minimum 12 years of professional experience in design management, senior design roles, or equivalent leadership positions within the defense industry
* Proven expertise in managing large-scale, complex defense projects from conception through delivery
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, or a related field
* Must be an Arabic speaker

  
**Additional Information**

*At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.* ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Title: Project Manager
Description:
Job Description

Project Manager, Infrastructure (UAE)

Role overview

We are hiring a Project Manager to lead the delivery of infrastructure projects across the UAE, from design coordination through construction handover, on time, within budget and to specification.

**Job title**

Project Manager, Infrastructure

**Department**

Projects / Engineering and Delivery

**Location**

UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Sharjah, with regular site visits)

**Reports to**

Projects Director

**Employment type**

Full-time, permanent

**Project types**

Roads and bridges, utilities (water, power, drainage), district infrastructure, marine or rail works

Key responsibilitiesPlanning and delivery

* Own the full project lifecycle: scope, programme, budget, procurement, execution, testing, commissioning and handover.

* Develop and maintain the project execution plan, baseline programme (Primavera P6 or MS Project) and work breakdown structure.

* Track progress against milestones, forecast delays early and agree recovery plans.

Cost and commercial control

* Manage the project budget, cash flow, variation orders, claims and final accounts.

* Review and approve contractor and consultant payment applications.

* Report cost forecasts and risks to senior management on a monthly basis.

Stakeholder and contractor management

* Coordinate with clients, consultants, main contractors and subcontractors.

* Secure permits and no-objection certificates (NOCs) from UAE authorities such as RTA, DEWA, ADDC, Dubai Municipality, Department of Municipalities and Transport, Etisalat and du.

* Lead progress, design and coordination meetings; resolve interface issues across disciplines.

Quality, health, safety and environment

* Enforce HSE standards in line with UAE regulations, client requirements and ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.

* Ensure works meet approved drawings, specifications and quality plans, including inspection and test plans.

* Investigate incidents and non-conformances and close out corrective actions.

Risk and reporting

* Maintain the risk register and run regular risk reviews.

* Issue weekly and monthly progress reports covering programme, cost, quality, safety and risks.

* Lead, mentor and review the performance of the project team.

Qualifications and experienceRequired

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

* 10+ years of experience in infrastructure project delivery, with at least 5 years as a Project Manager or Senior Project Manager.

* 5+ years of experience on projects in the UAE or GCC, with working knowledge of local authority approval processes.

* Proven record of delivering projects above AED 100 million, on time and within budget.

* Experience with FIDIC contracts and claims management.

* Valid UAE driving licence (preferred at hire, required within the probation period).

Preferred

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 certification.

* Master's degree in Engineering or Project Management.

* Experience with PPP, design-and-build or EPC delivery models.

Skills and competenciesTechnical

* Strong command of civil and infrastructure construction methods, specifications and UAE standards.

* Advanced programming and cost control using Primavera P6, MS Project and Excel.

* Contract administration: extensions of time, variations, claims and dispute avoidance.

* Familiarity with BIM coordination tools and document platforms such as Aconex or Procore.

Leadership and behavioural

* Decisive leader who builds accountable, multidisciplinary teams.

* Clear written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is an advantage.

* Negotiation and conflict resolution with clients, authorities and contractors.

* Sound judgement under pressure, with a strong safety-first mindset.

* Comfortable working in a multicultural environment and on site in UAE summer conditions.

What we offer and how to apply

* Competitive tax-free salary, with the package to be confirmed by the hiring team.

* UAE employment visa, Emirates ID and medical insurance for you and eligible dependants.

* Housing or transport allowance, annual flight ticket and end-of-service gratuity under UAE labour law.

* 30 calendar days of annual leave, plus public holidays.

* Training, certification support and a clear path to Senior Project Manager or Programme Manager.

To apply, send your CV and a cover letter to **admin@adcondxb.ae**

Pay: AED15,000.00 - AED20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Travel eSim Lead
Description:
Role Overview

The successful candidate will lead the Travel eSIM business end-to-end, developing and launching a competitive global Travel eSIM proposition targeting tourists, transit passengers and UAE-based international travellers.

The role combines commercial strategy, product development, digital customer experience, strategic partnerships and full P&L ownership, with responsibility for driving business growth and market competitiveness.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the Travel eSIM strategy, business case development, product design, launch and ongoing commercial growth.
* Own P&L performance, including revenue generation, margins, pricing strategy, customer acquisition and retention.
* Develop and optimise digital sales channels and customer journeys across e-commerce platforms, mobile applications, websites and WhatsApp.
* Establish and manage strategic partnerships with global eSIM providers, airlines, airports, travel companies and other distribution partners.
* Lead cross-functional teams across Product, IT, Digital, Marketing, Finance and Customer Care to ensure successful product delivery and operational excellence.
* Monitor global Travel eSIM competitors, market trends and customer insights to continuously enhance the product proposition.
* Identify new commercial opportunities, distribution channels and partnerships to expand market reach and profitability.

Candidate Requirements

* 10–15 years of relevant experience in telecommunications, digital products, international roaming, Travel eSIM, MVNO/MNO partnerships or consumer digital services.
* Strong understanding of the global Travel eSIM market and its competitive landscape, including providers.
* Proven experience launching, scaling and commercially managing digital products or propositions, with direct P&L ownership.
* Strong commercial negotiation, strategic partnership management and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
* Experience developing digital customer journeys, e-commerce platforms, customer acquisition strategies and conversion optimisation.
* Strong understanding of international connectivity, roaming propositions and global distribution models.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Telecommunications or a related discipline. An MBA would be advantageous.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A senior commercial or product leader currently working, at a telecom operator, global Travel eSIM provider or digital connectivity business.

The ideal candidate will have direct experience in Travel eSIM or international roaming propositions, with a strong track record of launching and growing commercially successful digital connectivity products.

Title: Manager, Client Engagement (1 year contract)
Description:
**Our Company**

BrandActive specializes in the financial analysis, strategy, and logistics of rebrand implementation. Since 1998, we’ve helped many of the world’s most valuable brands plan, budget, and implement brand change—optimizing spend, improving efficiency, and reducing complexity along the way.

  

Our work combines industry-leading analytics with a proven methodology to help clients make smarter decisions, save time and money, and get more value from their brand investments—whether they’re navigating a major rebrand or managing their brand day to day. You can explore examples of our work in our case studies.

  

At BrandActive, we’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive workplace where people can do their best work and grow together. We strive to set the global standard for excellence in our industry while fostering a culture rooted in trust, agility, and growth —guided by our North Star: great people, doing great work, and having a great time doing it.

  

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to a Director, the Manager serves as the project lead and is accountable for strategic planning, project formulation/scoping, scenario planning, cost estimating and relationship management that supports the conversion of the client’s branded assets to a new identity/logo. The Manager then oversees the project as it moves into subsequent implementation and roll-out phases while ensuring that the client’s needs are met.

  

To fulfill these responsibilities, the Manager typically works directly with clients at senior levels of the organization including the C-suite. When conditions safely permit, travel between North America and internationally may be a requirement.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Strategy/Analytics**

* Consult with clients about all elements for project scope and delivery, providing a high-level of expertise and instilling confidence in the client.
* Work with the client and BrandActive’s team to define the scope of brand transition across all branded asset categories (e.g. signage, ID badges, website, etc.)
* Develop several high-level scenarios to achieve brand launch and completion objectives using cost, time, quality and impact as the key variables.
* Provide senior leadership and their Board the information they need to make fiscally responsible brand decisions.
* Establish high-level transition strategies by branded asset category with priority given to those categories which are required for brand launch and have longer lead times.
* Formulate and comprehend overall implementation financials and to evaluate the implications of alternative strategy approaches on these financials at a macro and micro level.
* Develop cost estimates based on developed transition strategies.
* Define the high-level processes required to support an efficient implementation process.
* Create a high-level project communications plan to ensure engagement of all project constituents.
* Define the project organization required to execute the brand transition in a way that ensures achievement of client goals and desired outcomes.

  

**Project Management**

* Lead the project team, allocating and utilizing resources in an efficient manner and maintaining a co-operative, motivated and successful team.
* Communicate project status regularly (e.g. using dashboard reports) and escalate issues to stakeholders, sponsor(s), and senior leadership as required.
* Manage project deliverables in line with approved project plans.
* Manage or coordinate partners and work groups engaged in project delivery.
* Lead internal projects and client-facing (or conference call) meetings.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans (following PMI methodologies).
* Record, track and manage project issues and risks, escalating concerns when necessary.
* Manage project scope and change control.
* Monitor project progress and performance.
* Monitor the project budget.
* Create and present deliverables, and facilitate approval of recommendations.
* Review and provide guidance with new statements of work with current projects.
* Manage the creation of change orders with direction from the Director.

  

**Professional Development**

* Own your growth by setting and updating development goals, actively seeking feedback, and aligning your aspirations with business goals.
* Contribute to internal initiatives that impact the client and/or team member experience such as our Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion Advisory Committee, Community Impact Committee, or our Social Committee.
* Bring forward smarter, faster, better solutions to processes and identify opportunities to be more agile in day-to-day activities.
* Demonstrate inclusive and supportive behavior, contributing to BrandActive’s core values of trust, agility, and growth, commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion, (EDI), humanity, and wellbeing.

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

You might not tick every box, but if you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about the role, we’d love to hear from you. We value potential, curiosity, and a growth mindset.

  

**Education and Experience**

* Demonstrated commitment to life-long learning; post-secondary degree, diploma or certificate preferred.
* Three to four years of project management experience with at least two years as the Project Lead (managing projects from start to finish).
* Strong consultative skills gained through experience working as an internal consultant or in a professional services environment.

  

**Competencies**

* Superior written and verbal communication skills.
* Superior organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complexity including the ability to handle multiple tasks under pressure across more complex/multi-faceted projects.
* Presence including the ability and confidence to manage client calls.
* Proven credibility gained by consistently delivering on commitments.
* Demonstrated ability move across a range of projects and clients over time.
* Ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships both internally and externally.
* Excellent client contact, negotiation and problem-resolution skills.
* Detail-oriented, including the ability to identify important details, ensuring things are not overlooked and delivering a consistently high quality of work, keeping the overall goals of the project in mind.
* Demonstrated initiative including finding innovative solutions for the company and the clients.
* Skill in managing the relationship with the client and looking for additional opportunities to bring value and provide additional services.
* Taking action to make the most of the opportunities for the good of the company; takes a long-term view with the client.
* Leadership skills to lead a team of diverse individuals, providing oversight of their work, coaching and supporting them from a developmental perspective.

  

**Technical Skills**

* Excellent computer skills including MS Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project or other scheduling software such as Smartsheet or Teamwork Projects.
* At least basic knowledge and experience with MS Visio.
* Additional languages an asset.

  

**Compensation and Benefits**

BrandActive offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including:

* **Competitive compensation:** $100,000.00 -$150,000.00 CAD. Total compensation depends on experience, education, and skills and includes non-cash rewards. This range is plus commission.
* **Values led culture** focused on humanity, trust, agility, and growth. Check out our **Culture Statement.**
* **Comprehensive health and dental coverage** with no waiting period – your benefits start on day one.
* **Generous paid time off:** 3 weeks of vacation, additional office closures, Flex Fridays, and extended long weekends throughout the summer.
* **Holistic wellbeing benefits,** including a wellbeing allowance, flexible additional time off to care for a loved one, support mental health, or observe meaningful religious or cultural holidays.
* **Parental leave benefits** to support you and your family.
* **Home office and communications reimbursement** to help you work comfortably.
* **Charitable donation matching** to support the causes that matter to you.
* **Flexible work options** – Hybrid - with adaptable schedules.
* **Two annual town halls** in Toronto, featuring engaging sessions and fun team activities.
* **Supportive leadership and career development**, with ongoing coaching and feedback to help you grow and succeed, quarterly formal feedback, annual performance reviews and separate annual development meetings.
* **Work-from-anywhere flexibility,** with the option to work abroad for up to four weeks (in eligible countries and after a minimum tenure depending on the role and circumstance).
* And more!

  

**Start Date**

Immediately.

  

**Location**

Hybrid -Toronto, Ontario. BrandActive has an office in Toronto, ON.

  

**Job Vacancy:** This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope.

  

**Commitment to Equal Opportunity**

BrandActive is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values inclusion in its workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.

  

**Accessibility Statement**

BrandActive is dedicated to ensuring an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations during the application process, please let the Talent Manager know. We are committed to partnering with you to provide support and make reasonable adjustments throughout the process. All information received in relation to accommodation will be kept confidential and will be handled in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act.

  

**The Interview Process**

At BrandActive, we use AI within our recruitment process in the following ways: screening applicants and recording calls and interviews. All candidates will be notified of the use of AI at the start of a call or interview and can request to opt out. As part of our broader dedication to EDI, we continuously review and refine our use of AI to support equitable experiences for all applicants.

* **Initial Call (Pre-Screen):** If your application is selected, you will have a prescreen call with the Talent Manager where we will use AI to transcribe for accurate note taking.
* **Virtual Interview:** Followed by an interview with the hiring manager.
* **Case Presentation Interview:** The last step is a case study and presentation to our team.

  

We thank all applicants for their interest in BrandActive, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Senior Solution Architect - Core Networks
Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
At Capgemini Engineering, we are shaping the future of mission-critical connectivity across the globe. Our Connectivity & Network Engineering teams are at the heart of next-generation telecom transformation, delivering resilient, secure, and scalable core network platforms for some of the most demanding environments in the world. In Al-Khobar, we are growing our team of senior technical leaders who can own architecture decisions, drive multi-vendor integration, and lead high-performing engineering teams. If you are a seasoned core network architect who thrives at the intersection of technical depth and strategic leadership, this is the opportunity for you.
  
  
We are looking for an exceptional
**Lead Core Network Architect**
to own the architecture and technical leadership of mobile core networks for private mission-critical connectivity platforms. You will define end-to-end core architecture strategies, lead complex multi-vendor integrations, and serve as the principal technical authority across EPC, 5G Core, and IMS domains — ensuring every solution is resilient, scalable, and built to the highest standards of carrier-grade reliability.
  
  
In this role you will play a key role in:
  
  

* Architecting and owning end-to-end mobile core network solutions across EPC, 5G Core, and IMS domains, including subscriber management, policy and charging frameworks, and gateway functions, ensuring carrier-grade resilience and scalability for mission-critical private network environments
* Defining comprehensive core network architecture strategies including capacity planning, redundancy models, and geo-resilience designs, translating complex SLA requirements into robust, future-proof technical solutions that meet the highest standards of availability and performance
* Leading multi-vendor integration across RAN, transport, OSS, MCX, and security domains, managing technical interdependencies and ensuring seamless end-to-end interoperability across the full network stack in large-scale deployment programs
* Producing high-quality High Level Design (HLD) and Low Level Design (LLD) documentation, operational runbooks, and technical reference architectures, ensuring that all solutions are thoroughly documented and ready for operational handover
* Driving vendor technical and relationship management, acting as the primary technical interface with key technology partners, evaluating vendor capabilities, influencing roadmaps, and ensuring alignment with program objectives and customer requirements
* Leading customer engagement activities at a senior technical level, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders, presenting architectural recommendations with clarity and confidence, and translating complex technical concepts into business-aligned outcomes
* Managing and mentoring the core network engineering team, providing technical guidance, fostering a culture of engineering excellence, and developing the next generation of core network talent within the organization
* Supporting deployment, performance optimization, and acceptance activities, providing hands-on technical leadership throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure every solution meets design intent, performance benchmarks, and operational readiness criteria

Your Profile
  
  
We are looking for a technically exceptional and strategically minded core network leader who brings deep domain expertise, proven delivery experience, and the gravitas to lead in complex, high-stakes environments.
  
  

* 12+ years of experience in telecom core network architecture, with a strong and demonstrable background in mission-critical network environments and a proven track record of leading large-scale, complex core network programs from architecture through to deployment
* Deep technical expertise across EPC, 5G Core, and IMS technologies, including thorough knowledge of subscriber management, policy and charging systems, gateway functions, and the end-to-end mobile core architecture in both standalone and non-standalone 5G configurations
* Extensive experience leading large-scale, multi-vendor core network deployments, with the ability to manage complex technical interdependencies, drive vendor alignment, and ensure seamless integration across RAN, transport, OSS, MCX, and security domains
* Strong proficiency in IP networking, routing protocols, and security controls, with the ability to design and validate transport and security architectures that underpin mission-critical core network platforms with uncompromising reliability
* Demonstrated ability to translate SLA requirements into robust technical solutions, with experience producing HLD/LLD documentation, operational runbooks, and capacity and geo-resilience strategies for carrier-grade network environments
* Proven senior stakeholder management and customer engagement skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at executive level, influence architectural decisions, and communicate complex technical strategies with clarity and authority
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities, with experience building, guiding, and mentoring core network engineering teams in fast-paced, multicultural, and high-pressure delivery environments
* Experience working in or with KSA-based telecom operators or service providers is highly advantageous, with familiarity of the regional deployment landscape, operational expectations, and the strategic connectivity priorities aligned to Vision 2030

**What You'll Love About Working Here**

* Career acceleration programs — From associate to leaders and beyond, get support in your career at every stage with award-winning programs such as our leadership development program, Connected Manager, to accelerate your growth and develop your expertise.
* Worldwide Leader of Engineering Services — Capgemini Engineering combines its broad industry knowledge and cutting-edge technologies in digital and software to support the convergence of the physical and digital worlds. We help our clients unleashing their R&D potential to develop smart products and services of tomorrow.
* Dedicated innovation labs — We help the world's largest innovators engineer the products and services of tomorrow by leveraging our experts and labs, dedicated to topics as 5G, 6G, AI, Autonomous Vehicles and Quantum.
* Engineering Horizons — A global conference crafted exclusively for Capgemini Engineering colleagues, where excellence takes center stage. Immerse yourself in opportunities to showcase your talents and connect with the brightest minds in engineering across the planet.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

Title: Marketplace Operations & Partnerships Manager
Description:
**About NEEZO**

NEEZO is a UAE-based family lifestyle and services platform connecting families with children’s activities, experiences, products, and services. We are seeking a proactive manager to build and grow our marketplace partner network in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Vendor Acquisition & Business Development:** Identify and approach kids’ activity centers, play venues, sports academies, education providers, attractions, and family service businesses. Pitch NEEZO, negotiate commissions and offers, and manage the prospect pipeline.

**Vendor Onboarding & Marketplace Launch:** Own onboarding from signed agreement to live listing. Collect descriptions, images, prices, schedules, availability, and booking policies; coordinate account setup, quality checks, training, and launch.

**Partner Relationship Management:** Act as the main point of contact for vendors; resolve operational issues, maintain regular communication, update listings, and secure seasonal promotions and new offerings.

**Marketplace Operations & Performance:** Monitor listing accuracy, availability, booking readiness, partner engagement, and fulfillment issues. Work with product and marketing teams to improve conversion and vendor performance.

**Strategic Partnerships:** Develop relationships with nurseries, schools, parent communities, event organizers, and family-focused brands; pursue exclusive offers and co-marketing opportunities.

Title: Major Incident Manager
Description:
**Role: Major Incident Manager**

**Location: Houston, TX - Remote**

**Job Description:**

**Major Incident Manager**

• 5+ years of hands-on Major Incident Management experience in complex enterprise technology environments.

• ITIL Foundation certification required.

• ITIL 4 Practitioner: Incident Management certification preferred.

• Additional advanced ITIL certifications related to Incident Management, service operations, or service management preferred.

• Demonstrated experience leading high-impact, business-critical technology incidents through mitigation and service restoration.

• Demonstrated experience operating in a high-volume Major Incident environment, including managing multiple Major Incidents concurrently.

• Extensive experience leading technical and management bridge calls involving multiple technical teams, SI partners, and support organizations.

• Proven ability to drive teams toward service restoration while maintaining urgency, accountability, organization, and focus in high-pressure situations.

• Strong management and stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical situations into clear and concise business communications.

• General technical understanding of enterprise application and infrastructure architecture, including applications, servers, databases, networks, cloud services, integrations, and service dependencies.

• Strong understanding of Major Incident Management practices, including impact, urgency, prioritization, escalation, communications, and service restoration.

• Strong decision-making, analytical, and organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and multiple technical workstreams simultaneously.

• Experience working in complex multi-provider or SI environments preferred.

• Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable enterprise service management platform.

• Ability to work effectively with the SMO Global Process Owner, SI Major Incident Managers, SI partners, technical teams, and management stakeholders.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate Major Incidents from declaration through mitigation or service restoration, maintaining urgency and focus on minimizing business impact.

• Lead technical and management bridge calls, ensuring the appropriate SI partners and technical resources are engaged and focused on service restoration.

• Drive SI Major Incident Managers and technical teams to maintain urgency, accountability, clear ownership, and progress throughout the incident.

• Manage multiple concurrent Major Incidents while prioritizing activities based on business impact, urgency, and service criticality.

• Coordinate troubleshooting activities across application, infrastructure, network, cloud, database, and other technical teams while maintaining focus on service restoration.

• Establish and track actions, owners, escalation points, and next steps throughout the Major Incident lifecycle.

• Identify and escalate technical, resource, ownership, or organizational barriers that are delaying service restoration.

• Provide timely, accurate, and concise Major Incident communications to management, stakeholders, and affected organizations.

• Ensure SI partners follow established Major Incident response, escalation, communication, and contractual SLA requirements.

• Work with the SIAM team to identify and address SI partner performance issues, recurring concerns, coordination gaps, and areas requiring follow-up or corrective action.

• Maintain accurate Major Incident timelines, actions, decisions, communications, mitigation activities, and restoration information.

• Support post-incident activities and ensure relevant information is captured for Problem Management, follow-up actions, and continual improvement.

• Work with the SMO Global Process Owner to identify opportunities to improve Major Incident Management execution and SI partner performance.

• Work with the SMO Global Process Owner to identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve Major Incident Management, including documenting business requirements and supporting the development and adoption of new capabilities.

• Ensure Major Incident activities are executed in accordance with established processes, procedures, escalation paths, and governance requirements.

* Coordinate client training on using State Street interfaces (i.e. MySS.com).
* Serve on committees. Help define and implement new company initiatives.

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills in both verbal and written forms.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize assignments under tight deadlines.
* Attention to detail.
* Experience in relationship management, strong verbal and written communications skills, and some experience with presentations a must.
* Knowledge of securities markets, language and products as well as legal and regulatory requirements.
* Solid understanding of operational functions within both custody and fund accounting is preferred
* Good knowledge of computer systems, financial operations and related industries a plus.

* BS/BA degree required, with preference of Business degree.
* Minimum of 6-8 years related financial services or investment operations experience with 4-5 years of management responsibility.
* Experience in relationship management strong verbal and written communications skills and some experience with presentations a must.
* Knowledge of computer systems financial operations and/or mutual fund and related industries a plus.
* MBA desirable.
* Ability to travel up to 25%.

State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. Title: RN OBAT Clinical Care Manager
Description:
**Job Description:**

The Clinical Care Manager is a Registered Nurse who is part of the primary care practice team and is responsible for organizing, coordinating, and providing care coordination and care management services to patients within the practice who are most at risk for health deterioration, sentinel events, and/or poor outcomes. The highest risk patients are 1) transitioning to or from home and community-based health care facilities for acute care services (hospital or emergency department), rehabilitation services, skilled nursing services, or other community based services; 2) being seen in the office with co-morbidities, unmanaged disease severity, poor selfcare, polypharmacy, and high utilization rate. The Care Manager, as an integral part of the primary care team, is responsible for ensuring that the primary care provider (PCP) and practice team maintains a central role in coordinating and managing the care of these vulnerable patients and that the patients receive optimal care including acute illness management, chronic disease management, and preventive care across multiple health settings and multiple physicians/providers.

BSN in nursing required. Master’s Degree in Nursing preferred

Minimum two years’ experience in case management, disease management, home health care nursing, or intensive outpatient education/self-management support.

Professional Licensure/Special Skills and Certification Required:

CMCN (Certified Managed Care Nurse) or RN-BC (Registered Nurse Case Manager) preferred.

Reports to the Director of Population Health

Monday-Friday; 8:30am -5:00pm.

* Establish clear role expectations and responsibilities across the department.
* Identify training requirements and implement appropriate development plans.
* Develop processes, procedures and documentation that support consistent and effective departmental operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, communication, collaboration and sales growth.

Title: Vice President, Finance & Business Operations
Description:
CONTEXT
  
At Make-A-Wish® Canada, we’re redefining how the world perceives wishes through our transformative new brand platform: Wishes Are Medicine. Grounded in research, this platform recognizes what we’ve long known to be true — that wishes have measurable healing power. When prescribed alongside medical treatment, wishes reduce stress, elevate endorphins, limit emergency room visits, and deliver lasting health benefits.
  
With more than 3,500 children still waiting and a new child diagnosed with a critical illness in Canada every two hours, our mission has never been more urgent — and there are many more prescriptions to fill.
  
To meet this challenge, we’ve launched our new three-year strategic plan — Wishes Are Medicine: One Team, One Mission — focused intentionally on financial sustainability, mission impact, and operational excellence. When a child is facing a critical illness, a wish isn’t just a moment of joy — it’s a medically supported turning point. Studies show that children who receive a wish are 2.5 times less likely to have unplanned hospital visits and 1.9 times less likely to need the ER, with 100% of physicians agreeing that a wish can be a pivotal moment in treatment.
  
At Make-A-Wish Canada, you can play a lead role in bringing these powerful prescriptions to life. Where Wishes Are Medicine, transformation becomes a pathway to healing at scale — and this role is your opportunity to architect that future.
  
Our ambition to reach more children and families requires a strong financial and operational foundation. As Vice President, Finance & Business Operations, you will help shape that foundation, bringing strategic leadership to financial planning, investments, risk, governance and the services that enable our organization to thrive. You will turn insight into action, strengthen how resources are invested and managed, and help build a more resilient, disciplined and mission-driven organization.
  
At Make-A-Wish Canada, you’ll join a team united by a shared mission and an unwavering sense of possibility. Every role — whether advancing fundraising, brand, operations, or technology — helps fuel the same trajectory: transforming how hope and healing come to life for children and families nationwide. If you’re ready to help build a future where every eligible child receives the wish that helps them heal, we invite you to read on.
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We’re seeking a Vice President, Finance & Business Operations, a strategic and forward-thinking leader who will help shape the next chapter of Make-A-Wish Canada. This is more than a finance role; it’s an opportunity to strengthen the financial and operational foundation that will enable our mission to grow sustainably.
  
As a key member of our Senior Leadership Team, and reporting to the Senior Vice President, Transformation & Operations, you will bring together financial strategy, business operations, analytics, risk and governance to strengthen how we plan, invest and make decisions. You’ll provide the insight and discipline to steward our resources responsibly, improve organizational performance, and build the capabilities needed to support sustainable growth and greater mission impact.
  
If you bring financial acumen, business curiosity and enterprise thinking, and believe the strongest organizations pair ambition with discipline, this is your opportunity to help build the foundation from which our mission can grow and bring the power of Wishes Are Medicine to more children and families across Canada.
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
**Shape Financial Strategy:** Lead budgeting, forecasting, multi-year financial planning, and financial modelling. Translate insights into scenarios and recommendations that guide sustainable, mission-aligned decisions over a three-to-five-year time horizon.
  
**Steward Assets and Investments:** Oversee financial assets, treasury, and investment portfolio performance in accordance with policy, ensuring disciplined stewardship and informed decision-making.
  
**Strengthen Governance and Reporting:** Provide clear financial reporting to the Board of Directors and Senior Leadership Team, support the Finance & Audit Committee, and ensure sound governance, audit readiness, and compliance with CRA and other regulatory obligations.
  
**Advance Enterprise Risk Management:** Maintain the enterprise risk register, strengthen internal controls, and lead business continuity and disaster recovery planning to protect the organization’s assets, reputation, and long-term sustainability.
  
**Modernize Financial Capability:** Build stronger modelling, analytics, systems, and processes that improve forecasting, performance visibility, operational efficiency, and organizational decision-making.
  
**Lead Business Services:** Oversee property management, leases, contracts, insurance, and related business services. Balance operational efficiency and financial sustainability with investments in organizational capability and a safe, supportive workplace.
  
**Oversee Gift and Donation Administration:** Ensure sound systems and processes for restricted giving, endowments, estates, and other complex giving structures, coordinating closely with development teams to support stewardship and compliance.
  
**Advise and Partner:** Serve as a trusted advisor to the Senior Vice President, Transformation & Operations, the CEO, and leadership colleagues on finance, risk, and business operations. Bring an enterprise lens to strategic planning and execution.
  
**Guide and Develop Talent:** Build, coach, and lead a high-performing Finance and Business Operations team, creating clarity, accountability, collaboration, and opportunities for growth.
  
**Champion One Team Leadership:** Model One Mission, One Team leadership by working across functions and geographies, breaking down silos, celebrating collective wins, and leading with empathy, inclusion, accountability, and purpose.
  
**Represent the Mission:** Act as a visible and trusted ambassador with auditors, advisors, donors, partners, community leaders, and other stakeholders, supporting the Foundation’s presence and mission across Canada.
  
  
WHAT YOU BRING
  
You’re a strategic finance leader who pairs sound technical judgment with business curiosity and a hands-on approach. You move with ease between long-term vision and operational detail, helping leaders see the story behind the numbers and make bold, disciplined choices that bring the power of wishes to more children.
  
**Proven Financial Leadership:** 10+ years of progressive leadership in nonprofit financial management, with a track record of stewarding complex budgets, investments, assets, and financial operations in service of a bigger mission.
  
**Strategic Insight:** Demonstrated strength in financial planning, forecasting, scenario analysis, and investment and treasury management, building the modelling capability that connects strategy, data, and execution.
  
**Strong Credentials:** A CPA designation, supported by a bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, or a related field, equipping you to lead with rigour and credibility.
  
**Governance and Compliance Expertise:** Advanced knowledge of nonprofit financial management, CRA requirements, GAAP, audits, internal controls, insurance, and board and committee governance — the discipline that protects trust in our mission.
  
**Enterprise Risk and Business Operations Excellence:** Experience in enterprise risk management, business continuity, procurement, contracts, property, insurance, and service delivery across a national or multi-site organization, building a resilient foundation for growth.
  
**Gift Administration Knowledge:** Experience overseeing restricted giving, endowments, estates, and other complex donation structures, with a deep understanding of donor stewardship and the financial processing that honours every gift.
  
**Collaborative People Leadership:** A track record of recruiting, coaching, and developing multidisciplinary teams, building trust across functions and rallying people around shared goals.
  
**Clear and Credible Communication:** The ability to turn complex financial and risk information into practical insight for executives, board members, auditors, volunteers, donors, and cross-functional partners.
  
**Inspiring, Values-Driven Leadership:** Deep alignment with our mission and a commitment to responsible stewardship, inclusion, and collaboration — a spirit that motivates teams, breaks down silos, and creates life-changing experiences for children and families facing critical illnesses.
  
HOW TO APPLY
  
If everything you’ve read so far sounds like you, we encourage you to apply. Please visit the Make-A-Wish Canada candidate portal for current posting details and the application deadline.
  
Make-A-Wish Canada provides equal opportunity in employment and encourages applications from all qualified candidates. Reasonable accommodations due to disability are available on request at any stage of the hiring process.
  
OUR COMMITMENT TO IDEA
  
Make-A-Wish Canada is committed to Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Access (IDEA). We believe it is essential to our mission that we build a diverse, balanced, and vibrant workforce that reflects the communities we serve and seek to serve. Research has shown that candidates from underrepresented groups often apply only when they feel 100% qualified. Even if you do not see yourself fully reflected in every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
  
RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  
Once applications are reviewed, shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Our typical process includes a phone screen, two interview rounds, reference checking, an offer, and a criminal background check for the successful candidate. We thank all applicants for their interest in working with us.

6. Evaluate and help deliver roadmap items: Eximbills Microservices/cloud, digital trade, supply chain finance platform integration, trade-based money laundering (TBML) controls, vessel and shipment checks.

With more than 500,000 employees globally, TP combines high-performing on-site infrastructure with cutting-edge remote delivery models, providing support across 300 languages and dialects. * **Progressive Work Environment:** Clear vertical and horizontal growth pathways backed by structured coaching and tier-readiness programs.

* **Innovative:** Every idea matters—we empower operators to build new 0-to-1 playbooks and optimize operational workflows.
* **Inclusive:** A collaborative global culture where diverse perspectives are celebrated and everyone wins together.

**About the job**

As a Partner Customer Success Manager (PCSM), you are the dedicated post-sales commercial owner and strategic platform advisor for a high-value portfolio of 150–250 accounting firms, bookkeepers, and fractional CFOs. Within our partner GTM model, this segment represents highly defensible recurring revenue and the foundation of end-client subscription adoption. In this role, you protect the partner book against competitor migration, accelerate multi-product adoption (including Core Accounting, Payroll, Payments, Expense Management, Time, and Accountant Suites), and empower advisory firms to scale their practices efficiently.  
  
You operate through a proven Scaled Success motion—pairing an annual scheduled value cadence with real-time, signal-triggered 1:1 interventions and digital 1:many leverage. This is a high-impact role combining consultative account stewardship, data-driven prioritization, and authentic domain credibility.

*Competitive annual base salary, 60,000 Annual CAD, commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive performance-based incentive programs tied to portfolio retention, expansion ARR, and partner health metrics with an annual OTE of up to 10%.*

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**

The Partner Customer Success Manager executes across four strategic pillars to drive partner health, revenue retention, and ecosystem expansion:

* **Scaled Portfolio Management & Cadence:** Own and manage a designated portfolio of 150–250 accounting, bookkeeping, and advisory firms as their primary post-sales point of contact; execute structured annual value reviews supported by automated mid-year health check-ins.
* **Signal-Triggered Rapid Intervention:** Monitor CRM health metrics, engagement indicators, and platform telemetry in real time; proactively intervene 1:1 whenever risk triggers fire (e.g., stalled client onboarding, platform usage drops, or competitor migration signals).
* **Revenue Defense & Churn Prevention:** Protect whole-book partner relationships to prevent silent attrition of entire underlying client subscriptions, developing proactive recovery playbooks for accounts showing disengagement or decline.
* **Client Book Migration & Multi-Product Attach:** Partner with firm principals to migrate additional client books onto the cloud platform; drive organic expansion and cross-sell across ecosystem solutions including Payroll, Payments, Corporate Cards/Expense Management, Bill Pay, and Accountant Suites.
* **Practice Onboarding & Tier Progression:** Lead structured onboarding from initial introduction to accelerate time-to-first-value; coach accounting professionals through certification programs (e.g., ProAdvisor) and tier progression milestones.
* **Campaign Targeting & Digital Leverage:** Deploy pre-built expansion toolkits, educational webinars, and digital 1:many campaigns targeted at qualifying client segments across the portfolio to drive self-serve adoption.
* **Dedicated Partner Escalation Route:** Serve as the trusted, authoritative single point of contact for complex partner operational inquiries; coordinate with Technical Support, Approvals/KYB, and Risk teams to deliver industry-leading response resolution.
* **Voice of the Partner Channel:** Act as internal partner champion by surfacing recurring workflow bottlenecks, data-mapping gaps, and product enhancements directly to Product, Engineering, and RevOps leadership.

**Job Requirements (Minimum skills and technical requirements)**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree, College diploma, or equivalent professional experience.
* **Experience:** 1+ years in Customer Success, Partner Success, Account Management, or B2B Client Engagement within B2B SaaS, FinTech, or Cloud software (candidates with 1+ years in a high-volume, scaled CS motion demonstrating exceptional commercial results are strongly considered).
* **Domain Knowledge:** Demonstrated working understanding of accounting and bookkeeping fundamentals, compliance workflows, and practice management operations.
* **Portfolio Management at Scale:** Proven track record managing a large book of business (150+ accounts) using smart prioritization, automated triggers, and digital leverage rather than unsustainable blanket high-touch.
* **Commercial Track Record:** Demonstrated success in driving product adoption, expanding recurring revenue (ARR/NRR), and safeguarding retention within a matrixed enterprise organization.
* **Tooling & Data Literacy:** Proficiency with enterprise CRM and CS tooling (Salesforce, ChurnZero, Gainsight) and analytics platforms; adept at interpreting health scores, telemetry data, and task queues to guide daily outreach.
* **Bilingual Communication preferred (Canada Hires):** Exceptional professional verbal and written communication skills in both English and French (minimum CEFR C1 proficiency required).

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Commercial Acumen:** Balances consultative advocacy with strong commercial instincts to identify cross-sell opportunities, run business reviews, and articulate ROI to firm owners.
* **Data-Driven Prioritization:** Ability to filter signal from noise across large datasets to invest high-touch effort where it drives maximum retention and growth impact.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Skilled at motivating external partner principals to adopt new workflows while coordinating internal cross-functional partners (Sales, Product, Support, Approvals) to resolve blockers.
* **Accountability & Resilience:** Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ownership over commercial outcomes; maintains composure, focus, and empathy under high-volume demands.
* **Adaptive & Solution-Oriented Communication:** Smoothly transitions between strategic advisory conversations with firm leaders and practical, technical workflow troubleshooting with operational staff.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Accounting Certifications:** Foundational qualification in accounting or bookkeeping (e.g., CPA, CA, CFA, ACCA, ICB, CIPP) or official ProAdvisor certification.
* **Platform Experience:** Hands-on experience with QuickBooks, Float, Xero, or comparable financial management, spend management, and ERP software ecosystems.
* **Scaled CS Methodology:** Direct experience in pooled, digital-first, or automated customer success delivery models within global BPO or high-growth tech environments.

**Benefits & Perks**

  

* Structured career advancement pathways supported by self-assessments, virtual training, and guided leadership curriculum.
* Comprehensive paid 4-week product and onboarding training, plus generous paid annual leave.
* Continuous professional learning through progressive, tenure-specific certification and enablement programs.
* Competitive base salary complemented by performance-based incentive and quarterly reward structures.
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, plus Employee and Family Assistance Programs (EFAP).
* Vibrant, collaborative workplace with dedicated Rewards & Recognition celebrations.

**Schedule**

Fixed schedule: Monday to Friday, 9-hour shift (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM local time). No weekend or overnight rotations required.

**Location**

Toronto Office (75 Eglinton Ave East, Toronto) – Onsite

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**

We embrace diversity and never discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other protected grounds.  
  
Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment: We may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI) tools, to assist with candidate sourcing, resume evaluation, and interview scheduling. These tools augment our recruitment team and do not replace human judgment. All hiring decisions are made thoughtfully by our recruitment and leadership teams in full alignment with human rights and privacy legislation.  
  
Accessibility & Accommodations: Teleperformance welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all stages of the assessment and interview process.

**Be One of Our People:**  
It is our mission to always provide an environment where our employees feel valued, inspired, and supported, so that they can bring their best selves to work every day. We believe that when employees are happy and healthy, they are more productive, creative, and engaged. We are committed to providing a workplace that is conducive to happiness and a healthy work-life balance. We also believe that to be our best selves, we need to be surrounded by people who are positive, supportive, and challenging. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion and diversity, where everyone feels welcome and valued. Teleperformance is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Title: Senior Food Programs Manager
Description:
**ABOUT BEZOS ACADEMY**

At Bezos Academy, we believe all children deserve the great start that excellent early education provides, including in under-resourced communities. Our mission is to nurture the potential in every child to become a creative leader, original thinker, and lifelong learner by inventing the solutions needed to scale early childhood education. We are a unique organization that realizes our mission in two ways. First, we operate a multi-state network of schools in under-resourced communities, offering quality Montessori-inspired preschool at no cost to families. Second, we create tools, products, technology, and other solutions designed to reach young children and their caregivers well beyond the walls of our schools. We aspire to have a profound, large-scale impact on children ages zero to five.

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As the Senior Food Programs Manager at Bezos Academy, you will own the design, execution, and ongoing improvement of our multi-state preschool network's food programs spanning onsite food preparation, vendor-provided service, and funding through the federal Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP). In this role, you will ensure all students are nourished through a compliant, scalable, and financially optimized program that generates meaningful reimbursement revenue across the network whether the preschool is using vendor-supplied meals and snacks or cooking food from scratch on site. You will set up the metrics by which meal quality, food safety, and cost are measured and help develop training so school staff deliver strong results. You will lead improvements, from vendor procurement to new site launches, that keep food service standardized, compliant, and cost-effective as the network matures. You bring to this role the judgment to balance nutrition, compliance, and cost without compromising on any of them, and the operational rigor to ensure that every child in a Bezos Academy classroom eats nutritional high-quality food across states and sites.

* Arizona, Florida, Kentucky, Texas, or Washington and within two hours' drive to multiple Bezos Academy preschools (please see our website for school locations); Seattle, WA preferred.
* Relocation support is available for those willing to relocate to Seattle, WA.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

* This is a full-time, benefits-eligible, exempt (salaried) position.
* **The full salary range for this position, across all applicable United States geographies, is $113,000 - $216,000 per year.** The upper portion of the salary range is typically reserved for employees who have been in the role for multiple years and have demonstrated strong performance over time. Please see here for details.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Eight or more years of relevant experience, including five or more years of experience in project or program management
* Expertise in food programs for schools or other child-centered settings, including knowledge of early childhood nutritional requirements and regulations (USDA Child & Adult Care Food Program, National School Lunch Program, etc.)

* Demonstrated success in project management and related data collection, including the ability to utilize project management software to handle multiple complex projects, track progress, and communicate updates to key stakeholders
* Valid state driver's license, clean motor vehicle records, personal auto insurance (at least minimum coverage under applicable law), and access to a reliable vehicle
* Ability to travel to schools or attend team meetings up to 40% of the time depending on business needs

* Experience with managing food program operations across multiple states, relevant solution development and implementation, and end-to-end product delivery
* Experience evaluating operational feasibility and implementation impact, including assessing burden, workflow implications, and trade-offs
* Proven ability to translate complex requirements into clear, concise, and usable expectations

Title: The Berkeley Hotel Executive Housekeeper
Description:
**About Company:**

Looking for an inspired leader to head up our housekeeping department at the historic luxury Berkeley Hotel.

55 rooms. Previous hotel management housekeeping required. Must be able to work weekends. As this is a smaller hotel, the exec would be expected to have a board of their own near daily.

**Our Vision**

Our vision is to become the premier hotel development company with a concentration in Washington, committed to excellence through strategic development and continued innovation in the hospitality industry. Guided by our core values, we will exceed the expectations of our guests and members and enhance the value of our partners' investments.

**Our Mission**

Our mission is to provide the ultimate guest experience through exceptionally talented associates committed to providing true hospitality. We do this by providing support, training, and growth for our team members while being fiscally responsible to our owners and investors.

**About the Role:**

The Hotel Executive Housekeeper at Berkeley plays a pivotal role in ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness and guest satisfaction throughout the property. This leadership position is responsible for managing and supervising the housekeeping team to maintain impeccable guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces. The Executive Housekeeper will develop and implement cleaning procedures, schedules, and quality control measures to optimize operational efficiency and uphold brand standards. Additionally, this role involves coordinating with other hotel departments to support seamless guest experiences and address any housekeeping-related concerns promptly. Ultimately, the Executive Housekeeper contributes significantly to the hotel's reputation by fostering a clean, safe, and welcoming environment for all guests and staff.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 1 years of experience in housekeeping, with at least 1 year in a supervisory or management role.
* Strong knowledge of cleaning.
* Ability to lead and motivate a diverse team effectively.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working in a branded hotel environment.
* Familiarity with budgeting and inventory management.
* Knowledge of OSHA regulations and environmental sustainability practices.
* Bilingual abilities, especially in Spanish, to communicate with a diverse workforce.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead, train, and supervise the housekeeping team to ensure consistent delivery of high-quality cleaning services.
* Develop and maintain cleaning schedules, inventory controls, and quality assurance protocols to meet brand and safety standards.
* Inspect guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces regularly to ensure cleanliness and maintenance needs are addressed.
* Collaborate with the front desk, maintenance, and management teams to coordinate room availability and resolve guest requests or complaints.
* Manage housekeeping budgets, including labor costs, supplies, and equipment procurement, while optimizing resource utilization.
* Recruit, onboard, and evaluate housekeeping staff performance, fostering a positive and productive work environment.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations.

**Skills:**

The Executive Housekeeper utilizes leadership and interpersonal skills daily to manage and inspire the housekeeping team, ensuring high morale and productivity. Organizational skills are critical for creating efficient cleaning schedules, managing inventory, and maintaining compliance with safety standards. Communication skills enable effective collaboration with other hotel departments and clear resolution of guest concerns. Problem-solving skills are essential when addressing unexpected maintenance issues or staffing challenges to maintain seamless operations. Additionally, knowledge of hospitality software and budgeting tools supports accurate tracking of expenses and resource allocation, contributing to the hotel's operational success.

Title: Hotel Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

**Raffles Hotels & Resorts**

The Birthplace of stories and legends since 1887, Raffles is a legendary brand, steeped in history and loved by generations past, present and future. Raffles, at distinguished landmark addresses around the world, is the vibrant heart of its destination, curating experiences that are culturally enriching, intellectually stimulating and always respectful of local communities, heritage and the environment.

**About Raffles Doha**

Step into a world of refined elegance and timeless artistry at Raffles Doha, an iconic address nestled within the architectural landmark of Katara Towers in Lusail.

Raffles Doha is where luxury becomes deeply personal — a place defined by quiet sophistication, meaningful moments, and the art of thoughtful service. Rooted in a legacy of gracious hospitality, Raffles is renowned for creating experiences that are intimate, bespoke, and unforgettable.

Here, every detail is considered, every interaction intentional, and every guest journey uniquely curated. Our colleagues are artisans of hospitality, empowered to anticipate needs, craft memories, and deliver service with elegance, discretion, and genuine care.

Joining Raffles Doha means becoming part of a storied brand where excellence is not an aspiration, but a standard — and where hospitality is expressed as an art form.

**About the Application Process**

At Raffles Doha, we want to bring out your highest potential. Shortly after applying, you will receive an email from our partner AssessFirst prompting you to create a profile and complete a questionnaire. This is a mandatory step for your candidacy to be considered as it enables us to explore your compatibility with this role and our culture of luxury excellence.

 **Job Description**

We invite you to join the world of luxury hospitality at Raffles Doha as our new Hotel Manager.

The Hotel Manager provides strategic leadership and operational oversight across all hotel departments, ensuring the delivery of exceptional luxury hospitality experiences in line with the standards and philosophy of Raffles Hotels & Resorts.

The role is responsible for driving operational excellence, financial performance, guest satisfaction, and colleague engagement while ensuring seamless coordination and alignment across all operational functions. Working closely with the Executive Committee and department heads, the Hotel Manager translates the hotel's strategic objectives into actionable business plans, strengthens operational efficiencies, and drives a culture of service excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

As a key member of the hotel's leadership team, the Hotel Manager acts as the Managing Director's principal operational partner, ensuring the effective execution of business strategies, safeguarding the hotel's reputation, and reinforcing Raffles Doha's position as a leading luxury hospitality destination.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with the Managing Director to define and execute the hotel's strategic objectives and priorities
* Provide strategic leadership and operational oversight across all hotel departments
* Drive operational excellence, revenue growth, profitability, and continuous improvement
* Monitor hotel performance and implement initiatives to enhance business results
* Ensure seamless operations and consistent delivery of Raffles brand standards
* Champion personalised luxury hospitality and exceptional guest experiences in line with Forbes Travel Guide and LQA standards
* Oversee guest satisfaction, feedback, and effective service recovery
* Lead and develop the Executive Committee and departmental leaders, fostering a high-performance culture
* Drive colleague engagement, talent development, and succession planning
* Oversee financial performance, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and resource optimisation
* Maximise commercial opportunities and profitability across operational departments
* Ensure compliance with brand standards, company policies, and local regulations
* Oversee quality assurance, health and safety, security, and risk management
* Drive Forbes Travel Guide and LQA standards, audits, service evaluations, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Build strong relationships with ownership, corporate stakeholders, key clients, and external partners
* Collaborate with commercial and support functions to strengthen business performance and market positioning
* Promote innovation, technology, and best practices to enhance operational efficiency and guest experience
* Safeguard the hotel's reputation and strengthen Raffles Doha's position as a leading luxury destination

  
**Qualifications**

**What will you bring to this role?**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field
* Minimum 10 years of experience in luxury hotel operations, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership position
* Proven track record within internationally recognised luxury hotel brands
* Strong knowledge of luxury hospitality standards, including Forbes Travel Guide, and LQA requirements
* Strong Food & Beverage experience across multiple outlets, with proven expertise in managing high-volume banquet operations
* Demonstrated success in driving operational excellence, financial performance, and guest satisfaction
* Strong commercial acumen and experience in budgeting, forecasting, and cost management
* Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop multicultural teams and senior leaders
* Excellent strategic thinking, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills
* Extensive knowledge of hotel operations, quality assurance, and service excellence
* Strong understanding of health, safety, security, and regulatory compliance
* Previous experience in the Middle East luxury hospitality market is preferred
* Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage

  
**Additional Information**

**Employee Benefits**  
Join our team and enjoy a range of exclusive colleague perks, including complimentary upgrades, extended stays, discounted stays across Fairmont & Raffles properties, special dining and wellness discounts, and added luxuries to enhance your experience. We believe in taking care of our team, ensuring that your hard work is rewarded with exceptional benefits.

**Our Values**

Respect: We value the needs, ideas and individuality of others. We treat everyone with fairness and dignity.

Excellence: We make genuine connections, and we cherish every opportunity to make the people around us feel special.

Belonging: We celebrate our differences. We support each other and we always stand together.

Empowerment: We have authority to take initiative and anticipate moments that create unforgettable experiences.

Integrity: We build trust through mutual respect and being authentic.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team.

Title: HR Operations Manager – Manufacturing & Building Materials | Saudi Arabia
Description:
Leverage your abilities and join the dynamic team of a leading global manufacturer of building materials, supporting operational expansion and manufacturing initiatives in KSA.

The **HR Operations Manager** will own full accountability for the plant HR agenda, core HR operations, employee services, and team leadership, acting as a key HR Business Partner to plant management. The role offers executive HR leadership, team management, and the opportunity to drive company-wide HR practices, talent pipeline development, and operational efficiency across multi-site plant and office locations.

**Location: Jeddah/Yanbu, Saudi Arabia**

Key Accountabilities

* Supervise daily HR operations across all functions, managing payroll processing, benefits administration, employee services, and immigration/PRO activities.
* Own full oversight of HR operational budgets and administrative processes to ensure cost control and compliance across plant operations.
* Monitor HR service delivery, employee inquiries, and admin workflows to maximize team responsiveness and minimize operational downtime.
* Design and implement operational HR policies, procedures, and global competency frameworks across manufacturing sites.
* Ensure labor law compliance, route efficiency in employee mobility/travel, and regulatory safety adherence across all plant departments.
* Develop and maintain a smooth industrial relations environment, managing workplace culture, employee grievances, and risk mitigation.
* Lead, direct, and motivate HR operations teams, setting operational KPIs and guiding staff toward organizational goals.
* Mobilize new HR programs, talent initiatives, and onboarding schedules on time, covering manpower, training, and start-up plant operations.
* Partner with department heads on manpower planning, budgeting, and talent acquisition before committing to operational headcount.
* Collaborate with Plant Leadership on performance management, employee retention, and work with HSE on health and safety compliance.
* Set and monitor HR KPIs, resolving workplace disputes and reporting performance metrics directly to Country and Regional HR Leadership.
