Title: Marketing Operations Manager
Description:
Deep Knowledge Group · MarTech Department · Reports to the Head of MarTech

**The role**
------------

Deep Knowledge Group runs a portfolio of longevity and health-tech websites and platforms. Today the website tracking, the application analytics, the CRM and the campaign reports each work on their own. You will connect them: set up tracking, run the analytics and CRM systems, and make sure enquiries and reports reach the people who act on them.

**What you will own**
---------------------

### **Tracking and measurement**

* Create and run the company’s Google tag / GA4 account, install tags across Wix, custom-HTML and application sites, and remove the legacy tags that would double-fire.
* Verify sites in Search Console, submit sitemaps and keep reporting access working.
* Implement advertising pixels and conversion events with consent handling.
* Test that events actually arrive, with source, consent and duplicate checks, and keep a coverage record per site.

### **Analytics platform (PostHog)**

* Define a small shared event set, source and campaign fields, and how an anonymous visitor becomes a known contact.
* Run PostHog: projects, access, cost, identity handoff between domains, and event-based dashboards that update without manual spreadsheets.

### **CRM and automation (HubSpot)**

* Map form submissions, sources and outcomes into CRM contacts, with duplicate handling.
* Repair and maintain inbound email classification and routing, so every actionable enquiry reaches a named owner.
* Build audience segments with clear entry, exit and suppression rules, and run one follow-up workflow with the BisDev team.

### **Reporting and process**

* Keep dashboards labelled with data freshness and alert on collection failures.
* Document the setup so another person can run it: procedures, event definitions and a record of every automation and its owner.

**Your first 90 days**
----------------------

* Weeks 1–4: take over the new Google tag account, verify the priority sites in Search Console, and record a baseline of what tracks and what doesn’t.
* Weeks 5–8: agree the event and identity rules, and install tracking on the pilot sites in a way that survives page changes.
* Weeks 9–13: connect forms to the CRM, fix enquiry routing, and publish the first automatically updated dashboard.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years in marketing operations, marketing analytics or a similar hands-on role.
* Hands-on with Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Search Console, including consent and debugging.
* Experience with a CRM and marketing automation, ideally HubSpot (we also have Zoho in use), including forms, workflows and routing.
* Experience with an event analytics tool such as PostHog, Mixpanel or Amplitude, including user identity.
* Comfortable reading page source and network requests to confirm that tracking works.
* You write clearly and document what you build.

### **Helpful**

* Experience with Wix and custom or application sites, and Cloudflare.
* Server-side tracking or conversion APIs.
* Basic SQL or scripting.
* Experience with GDPR or similar consent rules.
* Fluent Russian.

Title: Director of Marketing

Manage the facility’s inquiry and admission process and provide customers with facility-related information via facility tours, personal visits/assessments, conversations, and follow-up. Coordinate and implement effective facility sales and marketing programs.

----------------------------

The Director of Marketing/Admissions is ultimately responsible for the facility’s census. While this individual cannot market nor fill the building themselves, they must be able to provide leadership to the marketing team that will lead to building and maintaining a high census.

This facility expects their employees to promote an atmosphere of teamwork with other employees and hospitality and comfort for its residents. Therefore, the following list of duties is not all-inclusive:

* Respond to inquiry calls from hospital discharge planners, families, and other referral sources. Conduct facility tours. * Develop and maintain relationships to advise referral sources of bed availability and new products and services, and efficiently meet the daily needs of the community at large. Promote the facility and its services to referring agencies. Maintain the current database of existing and potential referral sources.

* Alert appropriate department supervisors and building staff of projected changes, i.e. admissions, bed changes, and discharges, by chairing daily admission meeting to discuss forthcoming changes. Utilize bed management principles.

Recommend admission decisions to facility management. When admissions determinations are made, communicate with nursing and housekeeping about appropriate room and bed selection.

* Maintain a waiting list in compliance with state and federal guidelines.
* Maintain a working knowledge of Federal and State regulations and reimbursement (Managed Care, Medicare, and Medicaid). Provide assistance with new employee orientations on these topics and the admission process. Maintain a strong working knowledge of managed care referral process.

* Protect residents from neglect, mistreatment, and abuse.
* Protect the personal property of the residents of the facility.
* Others as directed by the supervisor or administrator.

---------------------------

* Eight years equivalent experience in a sales/marketing position or Director of Admissions position in lieu of degree.
* Organized and detailed in work performance.
* Good communication skills with excellent self-discipline and patience.
* Genuine caring for and interest in elderly and disabled people in a nursing facility.
* Comply with the Residents’ Rights and Facility Policies and Procedures.
* Perform work tasks within the physical demand requirements as outlined below.
* Perform Essential Duties as outlined above.

Title: Senior Procurement Manager
Description:
**Overview Of The Role:**  
  
  

* The Senior Procurement Manager leads strategic aspects within key Indirect Categories such as IT, Logistics, Marketing, and Human Capital across divisions on a global level. The purpose of the role is to develop and maintain organizational structures and necessary alignments to ensure an effective procurement process while providing high-value external solutions to support business projects in Saudi Arabia. This position acts as the primary procurement business partner for Business Units in KSA, ensuring alignment with budgets, strategy, productivity, and margin expansion initiatives. Success in this role involves designing and delivering comprehensive procurement strategies, fostering relationships with stakeholders, and maintaining operational compliance and governance.

  
**What You Will Do:**  
  
  

#### **Business Engagement & Demand Forecasting**

  
  

* Develop a deep understanding of business unit strategies, operational plans, and upcoming requirements across all KSA divisions.
* Lead structured demand planning and forecasting cycles to ensure accurate visibility of procurement needs.
* Maintain a rolling procurement pipeline for KSA, updated monthly and shared with regional category and sourcing teams.
* Facilitate early engagement between stakeholders and procurement to ensure timely planning and alignment with category strategies.
  

  

#### **Compliance, Governance & Policy Adherence**

  
  

* Ensure all procurement activities within KSA adhere to corporate policies, procedures, and delegated authority frameworks.
* Monitor compliance levels across business units and implement corrective actions where gaps are identified.
* Conduct periodic training and awareness sessions for local stakeholders on procurement processes, systems, and compliance expectations.
* Support internal and external audit requirements by providing documentation, clarifications, and process insights.
  

  

#### **Coordination with Regional Category & Sourcing Teams**

  
  

* Act as the primary interface between KSA stakeholders and category/sourcing teams based in UAE and Egypt.
* Translate business needs into clear category briefs and sourcing requests to enable efficient remote support.
* Track progress of sourcing activities and ensure timely delivery of outcomes (RFPs, supplier evaluations, negotiations, contracts).
* Escalate bottlenecks or misalignments and drive resolution to maintain service levels.
  

  

#### **Procurement Planning & Execution Support**

  
  

* Support the execution of sourcing events, supplier onboarding, and contract finalization in coordination with regional teams.
* Ensure procurement requests (PRs) are complete, accurate, and aligned with approved budgets and category strategies.
* Monitor contract lifecycle milestones and support renewals, amendments, and performance reviews.
  

  

#### **Stakeholder Relationship Management**

  
  

* Build strong, trust-based relationships with business leaders, project managers, finance, and operations teams across KSA.
* Provide proactive guidance on procurement timelines, market insights, and sourcing options.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to stakeholders, helping them optimize cost, quality, and risk outcomes.
  

  

#### **Supplier Performance & Issue Resolution**

  
  

* Support supplier performance monitoring by gathering feedback from KSA stakeholders and sharing insights with category managers.
* Coordinate resolution of supplier issues, disputes, or service failures in collaboration with regional teams.
* Contribute to supplier review meetings and ensure local performance data is captured and acted upon.
  

  

#### **Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement**

  
  

* Deliver regular reporting on procurement pipeline, compliance metrics, sourcing progress, and savings achievements for KSA.
* Identify opportunities to streamline local procurement processes and enhance stakeholder experience.
* Contribute to regional procurement improvement initiatives and support implementation within KSA.
  

  

#### **Local Market & Regulatory Awareness**

  
  

* Maintain awareness of KSA-specific regulatory requirements, local content rules, and market dynamics.
* Ensure procurement activities reflect local legal and compliance obligations.
* Provide insights to category teams to help shape regional strategies with KSA-specific considerations.
  

  
  
**Required Skills To Be Successful:**  
  
  

* Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and financial modeling tools.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to execute projects successfully and deliver external solutions timely, within budget, and meeting quality standards.
* Understanding of Procurement KPIs related to market insights, price and demand development, and performance metrics.

  
**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  
  
  

* University/Advanced degree needed.
* Master's Degree or other advanced degree preferred.
* CIPS (or equivalent) qualification.
* 10+ years of relevant business experience, preferably in Procurement, Automotive, Retail, or Real Estate industries.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The Property Manager is responsible for the financial administration, day-to-day operations and long-term management of the assigned property portfolio. Tenant Relations & Property Coordination

* Build and maintain strong tenant relationships through regular engagement, including quarterly touchpoints with anchor tenants.
* Review tenant sales performance, provide quarterly updates to the AVP and coordinate sales reporting and processing.

* Liaise with Leasing and Development regarding on-site tenant requests and coordinate tenant improvement allowances and landlord’s work in accordance with lease obligations and established responsibility matrices.

* Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively with all levels of management, both internally and externally.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and influence others.

Title: Retail Operations Manager
Description:
Retail Operations Manager – Kids Toys retail brand

**Job Summary**

Client is looking for an experienced and commercially driven **Retail Operations Manager** to oversee the operations and business performance of all Client's retail stores.

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth, improving store profitability, managing inventory, overseeing buying and merchandising activities, developing supplier relationships and ensuring an excellent customer experience across all locations.

This role requires a hands-on retail leader with strong commercial awareness, analytical skills and the ability to lead teams, identify business opportunities and translate performance insights into practical actions.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Retail Operations & Sales Management**

* Oversee the day-to-day operations of all Client's stores, ensuring consistent operational standards and efficient store management.
* Drive sales performance by setting, communicating and monitoring store and individual sales targets.
* Review daily, weekly and monthly sales results, identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions.
* Conduct regular store visits to monitor operational standards, customer service, sales performance and overall store execution.
* Ensure stores maintain attractive layouts, effective product displays, proper visual merchandising and a positive shopping environment.
* Identify opportunities to improve store productivity, sales conversion and customer experience.

**2. Inventory, Merchandising & Buying**

* Oversee stock management across all stores, ensuring optimal inventory levels and product availability.
* Monitor fast-moving, slow-moving and ageing stock and implement appropriate actions to improve stock turnover and sell-through.
* Plan replenishment and stock transfers between stores based on sales trends, inventory levels and customer demand.
* Oversee product buying and ordering activities, ensuring purchasing decisions are aligned with sales forecasts, market demand and business objectives.
* Analyze product and category performance to identify buying opportunities, reduce excess inventory and improve stock investment.
* Identify new products, brands and emerging toy trends to strengthen the company's product range and drive additional sales.
* Ensure new products and brands are effectively introduced, displayed and promoted across stores.

**3. Supplier & Market Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, brand principals and product representatives.
* Negotiate competitive pricing, payment terms, promotional support and other commercial arrangements to improve profitability.
* Follow up on purchase orders, deliveries, product availability and supplier-related issues.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, product offerings and pricing through regular market visits and industry engagement.
* Identify new suppliers, brands and business opportunities that can enhance the company's product portfolio and competitive position.

**4. Financial Performance & Profitability**

* Monitor sales, gross margins and overall profitability across all Client's stores.
* Review store and business P&L performance, identify key financial drivers and take action to address underperformance.
* Improve gross margins through effective buying, supplier negotiations, product selection and pricing strategies.
* Monitor discounts, promotions and promotional activities to drive sales while protecting profitability.
* Identify opportunities to control operating expenses, improve operational efficiency and maximize store profitability.
* Ensure effective stock investment and inventory turnover to support healthy cash flow and business returns.

**5. Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach and develop Store Managers, Supervisors and retail teams to achieve business and operational objectives.
* Monitor individual and store team performance, providing regular feedback, guidance and support.
* Improve team capabilities through training in product knowledge, selling techniques, customer service and store operations.
* Ensure clear communication of targets, responsibilities and operational expectations across all stores.
* Address performance gaps and operational challenges in coordination with Human Resources and relevant departments.

**6. Business Development & Reporting**

* Identify and recommend opportunities to improve store performance, expand product categories and enhance the customer experience.
* Oversee store improvement, renovation and development initiatives in coordination with relevant departments.
* Work closely with Finance, Marketing, Procurement, Supply Chain and Human Resources to ensure effective retail operations.
* Prepare regular management reports covering sales, profitability, inventory, buying, supplier performance, store operations and key business opportunities.
* Present business insights and recommendations to senior management to support commercial and operational decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Marketing or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in retail management, sales operations, merchandising, buying or multi-store operations.
* ***Experience in managing multiple retail locations, preferably in toys, children's products, specialty retail*** or a similar consumer retail environment.
* Proven ability to manage sales targets, inventory, customer experience and store profitability.
* Strong understanding of retail buying, merchandising, stock management, supplier relations and commercial negotiations.
* Experience reviewing sales reports, gross margins, stock movement and P&L performance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Commercially minded, results-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced retail environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on the following key areas:

* **Sales Performance:** Achievement of sales targets and overall retail growth.
* **Profitability:** Gross margin improvement, P&L performance and operating cost control.
* **Inventory Management:** Stock turnover, sell-through, product availability and ageing stock reduction.
* **Buying & Merchandising:** Effective purchasing decisions, product range development and supplier performance.
* **Operational Excellence:** Store standards, customer experience and operational efficiency.
* **People Development:** Team performance, productivity, training and staff development.

Work Schedule & Conditions

* Full-time position following retail operational and business requirements.
* Two days off per week, in accordance with the company's work schedule.
* Regular visits to all Client's stores are required.
* Occasional market visits, supplier meetings and business-related travel may be required.

Pay: QAR17,000.00 - QAR20,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience as retail operation manager or equivalent position preferably in toys, children's products, specialty retail or a similar consumer retail environment ?

Work Location: In person

Title: Director of Campus Safety
Description:
Randolph-Macon College invites applications for a full-time Director of Campus Safety. Reporting to the Vice President of Student Affairs (VPSA), the Director provides strategic and operational leadership to the Department of Campus Safety, ensuring the department supports the College’s mission of learning, teaching, and research through a safe and welcoming educational environment. The Director oversees departmental policies, personnel recruitment and training, and the implementation of standards for campus patrol, investigations, emergency response, crime prevention, special events, parking, and safety programs. The position also promotes open communication and collaboration between the department and the College community.

**Responsibilities**

*(Including, but are not limited to, the following):*

* Direct, manage, and supervise the Department of Campus Safety, establishing measurable goals, appropriate staffing levels, quality assurance, training, performance management, regular reporting, and continuous improvement. Oversee performance appraisals for departmental leadership staff, including the Assistant Director and Operations Manager, and delegate authority and responsibilities appropriately.
* Oversee the development, maintenance, and execution of the College’s emergency preparedness programs, including evacuation and shelter procedures, drills, tabletop exercises, and after-action reviews. Serve as a member of the College’s Emergency Response Team, providing ICS-trained leadership and preparing Incident Action Plans for major campus events.
* Develop and implement crime prevention strategies, policies, procedures, and training objectives. Identify and mitigate campus-wide security vulnerabilities and potential liability risks, recommending improvements to lighting, access control, cameras, and residence hall security in collaboration with Physical Plant and Information Technology.
* Serve as the Campus Safety Survey Administrator for the Clery Act, overseeing campus crime reporting, timely warnings, emergency notifications, recordkeeping, training, coordination with relevant College offices, and preparation of the Annual Security Report.
* Oversee investigations, including internal affairs investigations and complaints from the College community. Assign incidents for investigation to officers, delegate specialized tasks, and ensure appropriate follow-up and resolution.
* Build trust and maintain positive relationships with students, collaborating with Student Affairs to address substance-related incidents, respond appropriately to behavioral health crises, and promote trauma-informed, de-escalation-based practices. Serve as a member of the College’s Behavioral Assessment & Intervention Team and assist with programs related to The Edge Program.
* Establish and maintain relationships with local law enforcement agencies and other first responders, including local, county, state, and federal agencies, Emergency Operations Officials, CSX Police, and Amtrak Police.
* Prepare and manage the departmental budget and ensure resources are allocated effectively to support departmental operations and campus safety priorities.
* Serve as a member of the VPSA’s Senior Leadership Team (Coordinating Team). Communicate significant incidents, including those that may attract media attention, to the VPSA and other College administrators, and evaluate and recommend actions in the best interest of the College and the safety of the community.
* Oversee campus safety support for major College events, including Commencement, home football games, and other events requiring Campus Safety and Ashland Police Department presence. Maintain familiarity with the Rydin electronic ticketing system to understand how campus parking citations are issued and processed.
* Perform other duties as requested by the VPSA or Dean of Students.

**Knowledge, skills, and abilities**

* Ability to make critical decisions, evaluate sensitive or delicate situations, and recommend appropriate courses of action to achieve desirable or reasonable outcomes.
* Ability to motivate, effectively supervise, counsel, and evaluate employees; deploy personnel appropriately based on established priorities and situational needs; and apply effective human resources practices.
* Ability to plan, cooperate, and communicate effectively with others, both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to establish short- and long-term goals that support the academic environment and priorities of the College.
* Knowledge of crime prevention strategies and the ability to take active measures to promote campus safety.
* Knowledge of federal and state laws and regulations relevant to higher education, including Title IX, VAWA, Title II, and other applicable federal mandates.
* Appropriate training and understanding of NIMS/ICS procedures, including current certifications in ICS 100, 200, 700, and 800, Incident Action Plan development, and crisis management. ICS 300 and 400 certifications preferred.
* Current certification in Basic Life Support (CPR/AED) and Basic First Aid.
* Technical competency in Microsoft Office products and relevant campus systems, including Alertus, DSX door access systems, camera-based review systems, ADP payroll, Maxient, and Pharos (HIVE).

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in criminology, criminal justice, or a related field, or equivalent experience and/or training in law enforcement, security, or safety work.
* At least five years of progressively responsible experience in campus safety, public safety, law enforcement, emergency management, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience supervising personnel, managing budgets, and responding to critical incidents.
* Strong communication, judgment, conflict resolution, and relationship-building skills.
* Commonwealth of Virginia DCJS certification as a security/safety officer, or the ability to obtain certification within six months.
* Valid driver's license and ability to successfully complete a criminal background investigation and DMV review.

**Preferred:**

* Experience leading public safety operations in higher education, particularly at a residential college.
* Experience with Clery Act compliance, institutional emergency planning, and emergency response.
* Advanced training in incident command, behavioral threat assessment, and crisis response.
* Experience working with students and multidisciplinary support teams.

**WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

The position involves potential physical risks when responding to armed or belligerent individuals, trespassers, and injured persons, including exposure to bodily fluids. The position requires the physical ability to perform essential job functions associated with campus safety operations, including responding to emergencies and potentially hazardous situations. The Director must be able to protect themselves and serve the campus community while continually assessing risks and potential liability associated with departmental operations. As an essential employee, the Director must be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and participate in designated on-call responsibilities, departmental coverage coordination, and onsite emergency response.

**The College**

Founded in 1830, Randolph-Macon has 1500 students and is located in Ashland, VA, a residential community 15 miles north of Richmond and 90 miles south of Washington D.C., thereby having all the benefits for its students, faculty and staff of a dynamic metropolitan area which serves as the state capitol. Over 85% of students reside on campus. For more information about the College see www.rmc.edu.

Randolph-Macon College does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status in its education or employment programs or activities.

**Application**

Please complete an online application at https://bit.ly/4isHoqU to include uploading a resume, letter of interest, and contact information for two professional references addressed to: Claudia Burcham, HR Generalist. Screening of applications will begin immediately.

Title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
Description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
  
  
Canonical is hiring exceptional Sales Operations leaders and experienced analysts to grow and manage our global direct, alliance, channel partner and online sales. Our Sales Operations teams analyze and drive interventions to maximize net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.
  
  
You will partner with Canonical’s executive team across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal and provide a focal point to drive improvements. This position requires leadership, initiative and an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to drive continuous improvements in processes, systems, governance and data quality. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and the opportunity to design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.
  
  
**Location:**
*These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA, Americas regions.*
The role entails
  
  

* Delivering precise, scalable revenue operations for business through direct, indirect or online channels
* Leading and developing a team of revenue operations analysts in developing policies, driving processes and providing daily operational support and enablement to sales teams and partners
* Driving Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement/Data Enrichment, Customer Relationship Management, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions
* Instrumenting, measuring and improving policies and processes across teams covering the entire revenue operations spectrum
* Delivering metrics and reporting to monitor and improve revenue operations effectiveness, including new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals.
* Using data to drive insight, manage territories and channels, improve productivity, and agree and implement actionable change with executive management through regular sales and business reviews.
* Overseeing our sales technology and processes, driving automation and process improvements and partnering with our commercial systems engineering team to continuously improve business systems and integration
* Leading the introduction of new products, pricing, packaging and bundling through systems that are easy for sales and partners to navigate and quote
* Driving data quality, through order processing, new hire training, process documentation, reporting and data cleansing
* Leading and enhancing our commercial review process for evaluating and steering sales and alliance opportunities
* Owning the commission plan and leading the process for setting goals, evaluating and paying against that plan

What we are looking for in you
  
  

* Experience operating in a leadership Revenue Operations role, driving effectiveness of direct, channel and alliance partnerships
* Data-driven and analytical approach with a high attention to detail
* Track record of providing insight through robust CRM and other Revenue Operations technology platforms, data, analytics, compensation systems and processes to deliver excellent revenue operations
* An energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, a problem solver with skill in measuring, identifying and delivering systems and processes that ensure repeatable, scalable outcomes
* Comfort with commercial pressure, and the ability to put revenue teams under appropriate performance pressure
* Organisational skills and the ability to interact and work with stakeholders within all levels of the organisation
* Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
* Undergraduate degree in a related field, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
* Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills
* Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
* Ability to travel internationally up to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills
  
  

* Experience gained within a similar, technology subscription-based business
* Deep understanding of working in a global, multicultural organization including driving a team based remotely in multiple time zones
* Experience in mentoring and coaching team members on technical and soft skills, directly contributing to their professional development and performance improvement.

What Canonical offers
  
  
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  
  

* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

**About Canonical**
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
  
  
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
  
  
*We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.*

Title: Sales Manager - Tashkeel
Description:
**Sales Manager Tashkeel**

**Department**: Sales & Business Development  
**Reporting to**: Director of Operations & Commercial Strategy and General Manager  
**Working with**: Marketing Manager, Art Consultant, Design Consultant, Business Development Manager, Workshop Team, Graphic Design & Branding Team, and Accounts Team  
**Location**: Tashkeel, Nad Al Sheba 1, Dubai, UAE  
**Employment Type**: Full-time  
**Salary Range** : AED 15,000 - 18,000 per month + sales commission per quarter  
**Start Date**: January 2027

**About Tashkeel**

Established in 2008, Tashkeel is a Dubai-based art and design studio and consultancy supporting creative practice, professional development, and the growth of the UAE's art and design industries.

Tashkeel operates across education and outreach, workshops, exhibitions, artist and designer mentorship programmes, retail, and commercial creative services.

Its professional development initiatives include the Tanween Design Programme, Critical Practice Programme (CPP), and Art & Design Residencies.

Through its commercial consultancy, Tasmeem Tashkeel, the organisation provides bespoke art and design commissions, graphic design and branding, interior and spatial design, furniture and product development, manufacturing, corporate and VIP gifting, public art, and complete turnkey solutions for corporate, government, hospitality, and private clients.

**Position Overview**

Tashkeel is seeking an experienced, results-driven Sales Manager responsible for generating new business, securing contracts, expanding commercial partnerships, and achieving revenue targets across Tashkeel and Tasmeem Tashkeel.

The role requires a strong B2B sales professional capable of selling educational programmes, corporate workshops, wholesale products, artwork, branding, bespoke design services, and large-scale commercial commissions.

A key responsibility is identifying opportunities to cross-sell services across departments, transforming individual client requirements into larger, integrated turnkey projects.

The Sales Manager will work closely with internal specialists to develop commercially viable proposals, while maintaining direct responsibility for client acquisition, negotiations, sales conversion, and revenue growth.

This is strictly a sales position, not a marketing or creative management role.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Workshops, Courses & Educational Programme Sales**

* Work closely with the Workshop and Education & Outreach teams to increase enrolment and sales for weekend drop-in workshops, structured courses, seasonal programmes, and creative learning activities at Tashkeel.
* Secure contracts with schools for after-school workshops, term-based programmes, and recurring educational activities.
* Develop and sell corporate team-building workshops, employee engagement experiences, and creative development programmes to commercial and government entities.
* Establish annual and recurring workshop contracts with companies, schools, universities, and institutions.
* Understand Tashkeel's mentorship and professional development programmes, including Tanween and CPP, to identify suitable commercial partnerships and institutional opportunities.
* Coordinate workshop proposals, pricing, capacity, and scheduling with the Workshop team and Accounts department.

**2. Tasmeem Tashkeel Commercial Sales**

* Generate new business for bespoke design, product development, manufacturing, furniture, lighting, interior design, corporate and VIP gifting, public art, and turnkey commissions.
* Target developers, hospitality groups, architects, interior designers, luxury brands, government entities, corporate clients, and private collectors.
* Work closely with the Art Consultant on artwork sales, art commissions, public art, and art consultancy projects.
* Work closely with the Design Consultant on interior design, furniture, spatial design, and bespoke product commissions.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, long-term commercial relationships, and larger project contracts.
* Coordinate with the relevant consultants and production teams to establish project scope, feasibility, pricing, and delivery requirements.

**3. Graphic Design, Branding & Integrated Turnkey Sales**

* Actively acquire clients for Tashkeel's graphic design and branding team, securing commissions for brand identity, visual communication, packaging, branded collateral, and complete branding projects.
* Target new businesses, hospitality operators, developers, retailers, corporate organisations, and established brands seeking new identities or rebranding services.
* Work with the Graphic Design & Branding Team to develop client briefs, proposals, and commercial quotations.
* Identify opportunities to expand branding commissions into interior design, signage, furniture, product design, packaging, and bespoke manufacturing.
* Collaborate across the branding, interior design, product design, and production teams to present integrated turnkey solutions to clients.
* Maximise the commercial value of each client relationship by identifying additional services that can be delivered across Tasmeem Tashkeel's departments.

**4. Retail, Wholesale & Product Distribution**

* Identify and secure new wholesale clients, retail stockists, museum shops, concept stores, hotels, and design boutiques in the UAE and selected international markets.
* Manage relationships with existing wholesale clients, encouraging repeat orders and increased product placement.
* Negotiate wholesale agreements, minimum order quantities, pricing, and commercial terms.
* Identify opportunities for exclusive collections, bulk orders, seasonal products, and corporate gifting.
* Work with Retail, Production, and Accounts to ensure product availability, competitive pricing, and approved profit margins.
* Support revenue growth across Tashkeel's physical and online retail channels.

**5. Client Acquisition, Contracts & Sales Management**

* Proactively generate qualified leads through direct outreach, networking, client meetings, presentations, and industry events.
* Develop and maintain relationships with corporate clients, government entities, procurement departments, retailers, and private clients.
* Manage the full sales cycle from initial enquiry and client presentation through quotation, negotiation, and signed contract.
* Work with the in-house Accounts team to calculate sales prices, project costs, gross profit margins, and financial forecasts.
* Ensure all proposals and quotations are commercially approved before submission and that no consultancy or design work begins without an agreed scope and approved commercial terms.
* Coordinate with Project Managers and relevant departments to hand over confirmed projects for execution.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, sales forecasts, client follow-ups, and weekly pipeline reports.
* Work closely with the Marketing Manager to convert campaign-generated leads into confirmed sales, without responsibility for marketing or content production.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Sales Manager will be assessed against the following proposed performance targets, subject to management approval.

**Sales Revenue:** Achieve 100% or more of assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets

**Qualified Client Meetings**: 12–16 per month

**New Sales Opportunities** 10–15 qualified opportunities per month

**Sales Conversion** Convert 25–35% of qualified proposals into confirmed contracts

**Sales Pipeline** Maintain a qualified pipeline of at least 3 times the next quarter's sales target

**Corporate & Educational Contracts** Secure 4–8 new workshop, team-building, or educational contracts per quarter

**Workshop & Course Sales** Meet agreed monthly enrolment and booking revenue targets

**Tasmeem Commercial Contracts** Secure 1–3 new contracts per quarter, depending on project value

**Branding & Graphic Design Sales** Meet agreed quarterly contract and revenue targets

**Cross-Departmental Sales** Generate measurable additional revenue through integrated, multi-service projects

**Wholesale Expansion** Secure 2–3 new stockists or wholesale accounts per quarter

**Repeat Business** Generate at least 30% of annual revenue from returning clients and repeat orders

**Profitability & Collections** Meet approved gross profit margins and coordinate timely collection of payments

**CRM & Reporting** Maintain accurate weekly pipeline updates and monthly sales forecasts

Performance will be evaluated primarily on confirmed contracts, collected revenue, profitability, new client acquisition, and repeat business, rather than enquiries or meetings alone.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Business Development, or a related field.
* Minimum 7 years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or commercial account management.
* Demonstrated success in achieving revenue targets and securing high-value commercial contracts.
* Experience selling professional services, creative consultancy, branding, interior design, corporate solutions, bespoke products, or educational programmes.
* Strong understanding of client acquisition, pricing, negotiation, contract management, and sales forecasting.
* Experience working with corporate organisations, government entities, procurement teams, developers, and hospitality clients.
* Established professional network within the UAE commercial market is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in CRM systems and sales reporting.
* Fluent English required; Arabic is a strong advantage.

**Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a commercially focused B2B sales professional who can independently identify opportunities, approach decision-makers, negotiate contracts, and consistently close business.

They must understand how to sell both individual services and integrated solutions, recognising when a branding project can develop into a complete interior, product, and spatial design commission.

The successful candidate must be organised, proactive, confident in dealing with senior clients, and capable of coordinating with specialist teams without taking over their technical responsibilities.

**Compensation & Commission**

* Monthly salary: AED 18,000.
* Performance-based sales commission linked to agreed targets, collected revenue, and approved gross profitability.
* Commission will be calculated on eligible revenue actually collected, subject to management's approved commission structure.
* Opportunity to develop high-value commercial relationships across the UAE's art, design, corporate, government, hospitality, and retail sectors.

Candidates should submit their CV and a brief summary of their sales achievements, including revenue targets achieved, major contracts secured, relevant B2B client relationships, and experience in selling commercial services.

Applicants must demonstrate a proven ability to generate new business and close contracts independently.

Title: Sr. Safety Advisor
Description:

Toronto, ON, CA

**Position Title:** **Sr. Safety Advisor**
==========================================

**Who We Are**

The ONxpress Civils Contractor General Partnership, a partnership between FCC Canada Limited and Aecon Infrastructure Management Inc., is a multidisciplinary Civils Joint Venture (CJV) team with global expertise in delivering innovative solutions for both railway and civil construction projects. Working under Alliance agreements with Metrolinx, the team is helping to modernize railway construction across the GO Transit network.

  

An Alliance framework, which is relatively new in Canada, is a collaborative partnership between the owner and contractor, who work together with a best-for-project mindset. By streamlining decision making, the Alliance helps ensure that high-quality work is delivered, certified, and transferred in a progressive, transparent, and risk-managed manner.

  

The Alliance operates with a core focus on safety, efficiency, and sustainability, while fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and rights-holders and contributing positively to local communities as a good neighbour. Through this collaborative approach, the Alliance is helping drive the modernization of key sections of the rail network as part of the GO Expansion Program.

  

If you're passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a progressive and modern way of working, we want to hear from you.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Risk Assessment and Management:** Conducting comprehensive risk assessments of construction sites to identify potential hazards and implementing measures to mitigate risks to ensure the safety of workers and visitors.

* **Regulatory Compliance:** Ensuring that all construction activities comply with relevant health and safety regulations, codes, and standards set forth by local authorities and regulatory bodies.

* **Training and Education:** Providing training sessions and educational materials to construction workers and site managers on safety protocols, procedures, and best practices to prevent accidents and injuries.

* **Incident Investigation and Reporting:** Investigating accidents, incidents, and near misses on construction sites, determining root causes, and implementing corrective actions to prevent similar occurrences in the future. They also ensure that all incidents are accurately documented and reported as per regulatory requirements.

* **Safety Inspections and Audits:** Conducting regular inspections and audits of construction sites to assess compliance with safety standards, identify potential hazards, and recommend corrective actions to improve safety performance.

* **Safety Planning and Implementation:** Collaborating with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to develop comprehensive health and safety plans for construction projects. They oversee the implementation of these plans, monitor progress, and make adjustments as necessary to ensure ongoing safety throughout the project lifecycle.

* **Mentorship:** Provide mentorship and has the ability to coach and support team members.

  

**What You Bring**

* 3-7 years of experience working in a construction Health and Safety position.

* Diploma or Degree in Occupational Health and Safety or related field.

* Completed or working towards a National Construction Safety Officer (NCSO) certification is considered an asset.

* A valid G-class driver's license is a must.

* Experience working on rail construction projects is an asset.

* Strong knowledge of the Health and Safety Act, and legislation.

* Ability to effectively present information one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients and other employees of the organization

* Ability to respond to unanticipated events to ensure excellence in customer care.

* Ability to follow verbal and written instructions.

* Familiar with construction terminology.

* Strong team player who collaborates effectively with others

  

Expected compensation for this role is between **$90,000.00-115,000.00** annually. Base salaries are determined according to multiple factors including skills, experience and potential impact on the role. Internal and external competitiveness are also taken into consideration. In addition to base salary ONxpress also offers a comprehensive medical and dental program, RRSP with company matching and the potential to participate in our discretionary, performance based bonus program.

  

This role is a backfill position.

  

As part of our commitment to fair and transparent hiring practices, ONxpress may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and reviewing candidates. These tools are applied responsibly and in accordance with applicable privacy laws and ONxpress’ AI Usage Policy. All final decisions are made by qualified ONxpress team members.

Title: Trans Cost & Productivity PM, ACES TREX
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Transportation Excellence (TREX) team in AMET (Middle East, Turkey and Africa) is looking for a Program Manager to drive cost and productivity improvements across our Last Mile delivery network. The team is the single owner of labor cost optimization and productivity across the region. We work with Operations, Finance, Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Science teams to deliver great service at the lowest cost per shipment.  
  
You'll be based in Dubai and own a portfolio of cost and productivity programs in one or more AMET countries (UAE, KSA, Egypt and Türkiye). You'll find inefficiencies in route productivity, fleet utilization against paid hours, DSP capacity and channel mix. You'll measure the opportunity and lead launches from pilot to regional scale. You'll build and own weekly and monthly reporting and run deep dives on cost per shipment (CPS) and productivity drivers. You'll also present results in business reviews and help shape annual operating plans (OP1/OP2) with clear, data-backed targets.  
  
This role suits a builder who is comfortable with ambiguity and can move between detailed data analysis and leading teams that don't report to them. You'll be encouraged to use automation and AI tools to scale how we plan and optimize, and to raise the bar on how the network runs. Your work will directly affect the cost structure and customer experience of one of Amazon's fastest-growing regions.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  

* Own and deliver cost and productivity programs end to end: find the opportunity, build the business case, pilot, launch and sustain
* Track and report key metrics and explain what's driving changes
* Work with Operations, Finance, DSPs, Tech and Science teams to launch process and tool improvements
* Help set annual planning targets and track progress against plan
* Write clear narratives and status updates for senior leadership

  
About the team  
Transportation Excellence (TREX) is the central team that improves how Amazon's Last Mile network runs across the Middle East, Turkey and Africa (AMET). We work closely with the operations teams in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Türkiye. We own the programs that cut cost, raise productivity and improve the delivery experience across the region.  
  
Inside TREX, the Cost & Productivity team is the single owner of Last Mile labor cost and productivity for AMET. We look at the whole picture: route planning, fleet use, partner capacity and how the network is set up. We find where money is being lost and fix it in ways that last and work at scale. We work with Operations, Finance, Delivery Service Partners, Science and Tech teams. We also work side by side with the other TREX teams, such as Customer Experience & Escalations and Line Haul, so that savings never come at the cost of the customer.  
  
We're a small, senior team based in Dubai. We're hands-on, we rely on data, and we're always building. Everyone on the team owns their programs end to end, from the first analysis to launch across the region. You'll get exposure to senior leaders through our weekly and monthly business reviews. We're also early users of automation and AI tools in how we plan, report and make decisions. If you like hard problems, fast-growing markets and seeing your work directly change the business, you'll fit in well here.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, project management, operations, logistics, supply chain or related field
* Experience in lean or six sigma methodologies for operational, process, and performance improvement projects including process mapping and process re-design
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Speak, write, and read fluently in Arabic

Title: AWS Commissioning, ACx Amazon Commissioning
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. To meet the growing demand for AWS cloud computing capacity in EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa) we are now looking for a Commissioning Engineer to join the team.
  
  
Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning?  
  
As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of AWS owned data centres, Hybrid Colo's, Single Tennent Colo and Multi Tennent Colo builds . The AWS Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You will be responsible for supporting vendors, contractors and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:  
  

* Medium and low voltage power systems
* Generators
* UPS
* HVAC
* Chilled Water Systems
* Building Management systems (BMS)
* Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
* Testing and balancing
* Pumps and Hydronic systems

  
The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning, the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects.
  
  
A day in the life  
The CxE's daily focus is to ensure the commissioning quality and progress meet AWS's high standards by:  
Developing commissioning standards.  
Reviewing, comment on, and creating commissioning scripts L1-L5.  
Organize and attend meetings highlighting AWS requirements and tracking overall build and commissioning progress and blockers.  
Performing site walks to identify installation and testing deficiencies and maintain observation logs.  
Manage on-site 3rd-party commissioning vendors to ensure coverage of all Cx-activities.  
Gather, organize, and review design and commissioning documentation.  
Work with AWS partner teams to resolve coordination and delivery issues and report on project health and completion.
  
  
About the team  
The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCCD organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. We are focused on ensuring the rapid delivery of a quality product while maintaining full transparency, recording metrics of manufacturer/contractor/equipment issues pre-PFHO, and identifying opportunities for all our peers and customers.

------------------------

* 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
* 4+ years of commissioning experience
* Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
* Bachelor's degree or above in civil engineering, structural engineering, or architectural engineering from an ABET accredited program
* PE (Professional Engineer) or SE (Structural Engineer) Engineering license
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
* Knowledge of building codes, regulations, and standards including IBC (International Building Code) and ASCE (American Society of Civil Engineers)
* Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
* Experience in commissioning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
* Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance

Banyan is a not-for-profit organization that has provided quality services to the youth justice, children, and senior`s community support sectors since 1978. Banyan is committed to improving the mental, physical, and social well-being of at-risk populations in our service areas of Hamilton, Niagara, Brant, Haldimand, Norfolk, and Wellington.  
**Purpose of the Position:**

The purpose of this position is to co-ordinate and conduct the preventative and routine maintenance of the property, buildings and equipment of BCS, its related programs/services and its clients.

Reporting to the Program Director, the primary goal of the Maintenance Supervisor is to coordinate the inspection, maintenance, replacement or repair of equipment and systems, and major capital improvements in accordance with budgetary constraints, legislative requirements and industry best practices. The position will reflect best practices as define by BCS Policies and Procedures and PYC Practice and Procedure Manual.

**Position Responsibilities**

***Supervising and overseeing agreements:***

* Supervises the maintenance of BCS properties and buildings;
* Maintains, inspects and operates key building systems including fire alarms, fire suppression, water and septic, heating and ventilation and security;
* Responsible for recommending services of outside contractors in accordance with policy for building repairs, and maintenance relative to the needs of the properties and buildings;
* In conjunction with Managers/Directors, responsible for developing, maintaining, and monitoring maintenance services budgets;
* Responsible for overseeing the agreements with Ontario Realty Corporation and/or its agents in consultation with Program Directors/Managers as necessary.
* Ensuring monthly Fire Drills, Logs, and Extinguisher checks have been completed as per policy;
* Ensuring maintenance logs are maintained to ensure records are kept of maintenance procedures and expenditures;
* Liaison with Fire Department and Health Department regarding Fire and Health Standards;
* Performs maintenance and building repairs as necessary;
* Any other duties as required by management.

***Under general supervision, maintains security and safety standards throughout the building, by:***

* Maintain a key inventory, distributes keys from the main key area to the supervisor responsible for the key control;

* Repair door locks and closets as needed;

* Liaise with cleaning staff and supervisors regarding cleaning contracts and issues;
* Pick up and deliver work supplies (i.e., lumber, rental equipment, furniture, etc.);
* Assist the Program Administrator in documenting and recording inventory.

Title: FACILITIES MAINTENANCE & CONTRACTOR SAFETY OFFICER
Description:
**Job Summery**

  

The Facilities Maintenance & Contractor Safety Officer is responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of facility maintenance activities while managing contractor safety performance across the organization. The role focuses on maintaining a safe work environment, ensuring compliance with applicable health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements, and supporting the effective delivery of maintenance and facility management services.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Facilities Maintenance Management**

* Coordinate facility inspections, audits, and preventive maintenance activities.
* Ensure compliance with local building regulations, safety standards, and organizational requirements.
* Support the implementation of energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives within facility operations.
* Monitor facility conditions and recommend corrective or improvement actions.
  

**Contractor Safety Management**

* Develop, implement, and enforce contractor safety policies and procedures.
* Conduct contractor pre-qualification assessments to evaluate safety performance, certifications, and compliance records.
* Review and approve Permit-to-Work (PTW) documentation, risk assessments, and method statements before work commences.
* Ensure hazards are identified and appropriate control measures are implemented.
* Conduct contractor inductions, safety briefings, and toolbox talks.
* Monitor contractor activities to ensure compliance with safety standards and PPE requirements.
* Maintain accurate PTW records and suspend permits when safety conditions are not met.
  

**Safety Inspections & Compliance**

* Conduct regular workplace safety inspections and facility audits.
* Identify safety hazards and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses to determine root causes and preventive measures.
* Ensure compliance with fire safety requirements, emergency procedures, and hazardous material management.
* Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and related safety documentation.
* Liaise with regulatory authorities and external auditors during inspections and compliance reviews.
  

**Emergency Preparedness & Response**

* Ensure fire protection systems, emergency exits, alarms, and first-aid facilities are properly maintained.
* Develop and coordinate emergency response and evacuation plans.
* Organize and monitor fire drills and emergency exercises.
* Act as a key liaison between facility management, emergency responders, and regulatory authorities during emergencies.
  

**Audits and Inspections**

* Conduct routine HSE inspections, fire risk assessments, and compliance audits.
* Utilize inspection checklists and assessment tools to evaluate workplace safety.
* Document findings and communicate corrective actions to relevant stakeholders.
* Support external audits and regulatory inspections.
  

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain records related to maintenance activities, inspections, permits, audits, incidents, and risk assessments.
* Prepare periodic HSE and facility performance reports.
* Track contractor compliance metrics and monitor adherence to contractual HSE obligations.
* Maintain accurate records in accordance with company and regulatory requirements.
  

**Daily Operational Support**

* Support the Research Safety Manager in implementing HSE and facilities management strategies.
* Monitor compliance with HSE policies, procedures, and standards across operations.
* Ensure subcontractors and service providers comply with organizational HSE requirements.
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  

**Operating Environment**

* Work is performed in both office and field environments.
* Travel to various facilities and regulatory agencies may be required.
* Availability to respond to emergencies outside normal working hours is essential.
* Exposure to varying environmental conditions, hazardous materials, chemicals, animals, toxic plants, and specialized equipment may occur.
* Use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required when necessary.
* Physical activities may include standing, walking, climbing, bending, and lifting.
* Ability to work in confined spaces, at heights, and in challenging environmental conditions.
  

**Communication & Working Relationships**

  

**Research Safety Manager**

* Provide regular updates on compliance performance, risk assessments, incidents, and corrective actions.
* Report daily operational activities and seek guidance when required.
* Present audit findings and improvement recommendations.
  

**HSE Team**

* Collaborate on risk assessments, audits, inspections, and training activities.
* Share best practices and regulatory updates.
* Support emergency response planning and drills.
  

**Facilities Management Personnel & Contractors**

* Coordinate maintenance activities and safety requirements.
* Ensure safe execution of work and compliance with operational procedures.
* Address facility-related hazards and environmental concerns.
  

**Regulatory Authorities & External Stakeholders**

* Submit compliance reports and required documentation.
* Facilitate inspections conducted by regulatory bodies.
* Implement recommendations arising from external audits and reviews.
* Participate in professional forums and industry networks to maintain awareness of best practices.
  

**Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

  

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Facilities Management, Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related discipline.
  

**Professional Certifications (Preferred)**

* NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC)
* Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
* Certified Facilities Manager (CFM)
* Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH)
* Construction Health & Safety Technician (CHST)
* Project Management Professional (PMP)
  

**Experience**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in Facilities Management, Occupational Health & Safety, or Environmental Health & Safety.
* Experience conducting risk assessments, incident investigations, compliance audits, and safety inspections.
* Experience managing contractors and Permit-to-Work systems.
  

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of HSE regulations, facility management principles, and safety management systems.
* Understanding of environmental and occupational safety standards, including OSHA, NFPA, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and relevant Qatar regulations.
* Knowledge of emergency preparedness and incident management.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and training skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Power BI, and HSE management software.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 management systems.

Title: LABORATORY HSE OFFICER
Description:
**Job Summery**

  

The Laboratory HSE Officer is responsible for supporting and implementing Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) programs across laboratory and research facilities. The role ensures compliance with applicable HSE regulations, university policies, and international standards while promoting a proactive safety culture. The incumbent will oversee risk assessments, inspections, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, training programs, and regulatory compliance activities to ensure a safe environment for staff, students, researchers, contractors, and visitors.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**HSE Program Development and Compliance**

  

* Support the Research Safety Manager in developing, implementing, and maintaining laboratory HSE policies, procedures, and programs.
* Ensure laboratory operations comply with applicable local and international HSE regulations and standards.
* Monitor regulatory developments and update policies, procedures, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as required.
* Collaborate with laboratory managers, facilities teams, HSE focal points, and other stakeholders to integrate HSE requirements into daily operations.
* Promote continuous improvement in laboratory health, safety, and environmental performance.
  

**Technical Support and Project Contribution**

  

* Conduct and oversee chemical, biological, radiological, and environmental safety assessments across laboratories and research facilities.
* Support the development and delivery of safety programs related to laboratory operations.
* Provide technical guidance on HSE matters to faculty, researchers, staff, and contractors.
* Assist in planning and allocating resources required for HSE initiatives and projects.
* Act as a technical resource for environmental, health, and safety management activities.
  

**Risk Assessment and Risk Management**

  

* Conduct workplace inspections and risk assessments to identify hazards and associated risks.
* Develop and implement appropriate risk control measures.
* Monitor the effectiveness of risk mitigation actions and recommend improvements where necessary.
* Maintain risk assessment records and ensure periodic reviews are completed.
* Support institutional risk management initiatives related to laboratory activities.
  

**Training and Awareness**

  

* Develop and deliver HSE induction programs, awareness campaigns, and specialized laboratory safety training.
* Ensure employees, students, researchers, and contractors understand HSE policies and emergency procedures.
* Maintain training records and monitor compliance with mandatory HSE training requirements.
* Promote a positive safety culture through regular communication and engagement activities.
  

**Incident Investigation and Reporting**

  

* Investigate incidents, accidents, near misses, hazardous occurrences, and environmental events.
* Collect evidence, interview relevant personnel, and determine root causes.
* Prepare detailed investigation reports with recommendations and corrective actions.
* Monitor implementation and effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate incident records and statistics.
  

**Inspections, Audits, and Compliance Monitoring**

  

* Conduct and coordinate routine laboratory inspections, safety audits, and fire risk assessments.
* Monitor compliance with legislation, university requirements, and management systems.
* Identify non-conformities and coordinate corrective actions with relevant departments.

**Your Impact:**

  

As a Safety & Security Data Analyst, you will transform operational and documentary data into clear insights that strengthen decision-making and help protect our people, boutiques, assets and brand across the UAE. Working closely with the Head of Safety & Security and key business stakeholders, you will build datasets, identify emerging patterns, improve operational consistency and support a more proactive, evidence-based approach to safety and security management.

* Strong analytical thinking, intellectual curiosity and the ability to identify meaningful patterns in complex datasets.

* High ethical standards, professional integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information.

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and practical experience with Microsoft Power BI

* Ability to work independently, maintain accuracy under time pressure and collaborate effectively across functions.

Title: Chief Medical Officer
Description:

Reporting directly to the President & Chief Executive Officer (CEO), the CMO promotes high-quality, accessible, evidence-based healthcare consistent with CHA's mission as a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC).

The CMO serves as the organization's senior medical leader, supporting providers, strengthening clinical practices, identifying barriers to effective care, and collaborating with Operations and executive leadership to improve patient outcomes and the overall delivery of medical services.

* Ability to maintain required professional credentials, certifications, and clinical privileges.g

**Professional Experience**
---------------------------

* Minimum of three years of medical leadership or management experience; five or more years preferred.
